title.zh: 允许在1954年1月1日至6月30日期间支用菲律宾国库于同期内所获得的一般基金、特别基金、信托基金及其他基金收入的法案
title.en: An Act Allowing the Expenditure During the Period from January First to June Thirty, Nineteen Hundred and Fifty-Four, of the Income Accruing to the General, Special, Trust and Other Funds in the Philippine Treasury During the Same Period, and for Other Purposes
title.orig: An Act Allowing the Expenditure During the Period from January First to June Thirty, Nineteen Hundred and Fifty-Four, of the Income Accruing to the General, Special, Trust and Other Funds in the Philippine Treasury During the Same Period, and for Other Purposes
title.vi: Đạo luật cho phép chi tiêu thu nhập phát sinh từ Quỹ Chung, Quỹ Đặc biệt, Quỹ Ủy thác và các Quỹ Khác tại Kho bạc Philippines trong giai đoạn từ ngày 1 tháng 1 đến ngày 30 tháng 6 năm 1954
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติอนุญาตให้ใช้จ่ายรายได้ที่เกิดขึ้นจากกองทุนทั่วไปกองทุนพิเศษกองทุนความไว้วางใจและกองทุนอื่นๆในคลังพระมหากษัตริย์ฟิลิปปินส์ในช่วงระหว่างวันที่1มกราคมถึงวันที่30มิถุนายนพุทธศักราช2497
title.id: Undang-Undang Mengizinkan Pengeluaran Pendapatan yang Diperoleh dari Dana Umum, Dana Khusus, Dana Perwalian, dan Dana Lainnya di Kas Umum Filipina Selama Periode 1 Januari hingga 30 Juni 1954
title.ms: Akta Membenarkan Perbelanjaan Hasil yang Diperoleh daripada Dana Am Dana Khas Dana Amanah dan Dana Lain-lain di Perbendaharaan Filipina semasa Tempoh dari 1 Januari hingga 30 Jun 1954

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1954/ra_1193_1954.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The expenditure during the period from January first to June thirty, nineteen hundred and fifty-four, in pursuance of appropriations made by law prior to the approval of this Act, of the income accruing to the general, special, trust and other funds in the Philippine Treasury during the said period is hereby authorized; Provided, However , That the expenditures from special and trust funds during the same period shall have been made solely for the purposes for which said special and trust funds were created.

This Act shall take effect as of January first, nineteen hundred and fifty-four.
Approved: August 25, 1954.
